control: Rigid bench and fixture load path
acceptance_evidence: Deflection and fastener capacity supported by calculation plus inspection
Contains link and load with actuator unpowered and after any single test-fixture control failure
Prevents access to pinch/sweep volume while allowing instrumentation
As-built perpendicular distance measured with uncertainty; no nominal-only credit
Alignment and off-axis sensitivity quantified across all test angles
No human-held weights, force gauges or straps inside the moving volume
Independent, accessible removal of actuator-branch energy; exact device/duty selection required
External source limit and actuator register limit independently reviewed and recorded
Source, wiring and interruption devices reviewed for regenerated/back-driven energy
Attachment method does not insulate the case or enter moving/pinch paths
Strain relief, bend radius, separation and temperature-sensor locations documented
Qualified mechanical/electrical reviewers sign the as-built fixture and limits before powered work
